gate: REH14 manifest re-read cost; offline unit checks, no runtime gate passed

change.events: only intake.item changes carry itemId (CaseIngestionChangeSchema; appendIntakeItemTx); batchFrame now hands that id to each consumer, every other refresh (target, recipe, ready, resync, 409, quiet tick) names none
change.client: IntakeItemRefresh (apps/studio/src/features/intake/item-refresh.ts): an item the cached manifest holds is read by GET .../intake/items/{itemId} and replaced in place with setQueryData; the reads under ['intake', caseId] (sections, evidence) are asked again as before; recipe and package summary reads unchanged
change.fallback: full manifest re-read by ZP2's rereadQuery for a change without an item, an item the cache does not hold (new or hidden member), a changed wave, name, sourceId or parentItemId (its place or listing would move), and any failed item read (404 for a removed item)
change.coalescing: changes to one item in the same turn share one read (microtask); a change during that item's read asks for one more after it; item reads wait while a manifest read is in flight; an item a later manifest left out is not put back
change.server: one() and manifest() share itemSelect and intakeItem, so the shape and the 'Taken out of <zip>.' words agree; one() still answers a member the manifest hides, and the client merges only items its manifest holds; no server or authority change

names: an item change reads that item alone and puts it in its place, with no manifest read
a new item reads the manifest once
two changes to one item in quick succession give one item read
a failed item read, or an item whose place would move, falls back to the manifest read
an item change waits for the manifest read in flight, and an item it left out is not put back

tests.name: an intake.item change hands its item to the consumers; a target change and the quiet read name none
the one-item read answers each listed row exactly as the manifest lists it; a member hidden stays out

checks.report: no screen, markup or style changed

contract: unchanged: existing one-item route; no openapi change
gaps: offline only; a runtime rehearsal under load should count manifest reads against item reads
the map surface layer (useSurfaceLayer) still re-reads the whole manifest on every change
